story1.title: Rosie Hops on a Rainy Day
pages: Rosie hops out in the rain.

She hops through soft green grass.
She sits and watches fish swim.

story2.title: Rosie Splashes by the River
pages: Rosie lives near the wide river.

Rosie waves at the duck and smiles.
